description: This source file contains test functions for the storage lock management component, verifying correct behavior of acquiring, releasing, renewing, and querying locks, including edge cases and concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_Success
methods.description: Tests successful acquisition of a lock and its properties.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_DefaultTimeout
methods.description: Tests that acquiring a lock with zero timeout defaults to 30 seconds.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_AlreadyHeld
methods.description: Ensures that acquiring a lock on an already held key results in an error.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_ExpiredLock
methods.description: Verifies that a lock can be reacquired after expiration.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Ensures that acquiring a lock with a canceled context fails immediately.

methods.name: TestReleaseLock_Success
methods.description: Tests successful lock release and re-acquisition.

methods.name: TestReleaseLock_NotFound
methods.description: Verifies error when releasing a non-existent lock.

methods.name: TestReleaseLock_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Ensures releasing a lock with a canceled context immediately fails.

methods.name: TestRenewLock_Success
methods.description: Tests successful renewal of a lock, extending its expiration.

methods.name: TestRenewLock_NotFound
methods.description: Checks error when renewing a non-existent lock.

methods.name: TestRenewLock_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Ensures renewing a lock with a canceled context immediately fails.

methods.name: TestGetLockStatus_Exists
methods.description: Verifies retrieving status of an existing lock.

methods.name: TestGetLockStatus_NotExists
methods.description: Checks that querying a non-existent lock returns nil status.

methods.name: TestGetLockStatus_Expired
methods.description: Verifies that expired locks are reflected as such in status.

methods.name: TestGetLockStatus_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Ensures that canceled context results in immediate error on status query.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_Concurrent
methods.description: Tests that only one goroutine can acquire the lock among multiple concurrent attempts.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_RaceCondition
methods.description: Verifies that multiple concurrent attempts to acquire the same lock key result in only one success.

methods.name: TestReleaseLock_Concurrent
methods.description: Checks that only one concurrent release of a lock succeeds.

methods.name: TestRenewLock_Concurrent
methods.description: Ensures multiple concurrent renewals succeed without errors.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_EmptyKey
methods.description: Checks behavior when acquiring a lock with an empty key.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_VeryLongKey
methods.description: Tests handling of very long lock keys.

methods.name: TestAcquireLock_NegativeTimeout
methods.description: Verifies default timeout usage when given negative timeout.

methods.name: TestAcquireReleaseCycle
methods.description: Performs multiple acquire-release cycles for robustness.

methods.name: TestLockExpiration_AutomaticCleanup
methods.description: Verifies that locks expire automatically and can be reacquired afterward.
